event: Nala asks how Iris can talk to her through windows that are only supposed to hold facts.
Iris says the windows are hers: she writes every one, levels, classes and quests alike.
Iris says keeping to facts is the rule, because the System doesn't take sides.
Iris says a window saying more than the facts takes a side, and she has broken that rule with Nala.
Iris counts three times, then corrects herself to four.
A thin cloud slides off the sun, warming the light on the clover and the worn arc on the plinth.
Iris says she is not sorry, and thought Nala should know.
